notes.semetey-1-2013:p0847:b003:l009: Tort-Kulcho retained as the source's capitalized, hyphenated mound/place expression; precise geographical identification unverified.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0847:b003:l010: The lament addresses dead Manas as though he might not die; counterfactual wording retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0847:b003:l025: Primary Yudakhin сан II3 can mean an innumerable host or, in epic numbers, ten thousand. Sixty thousand is a provisional numeric reading of алты сан, not a certified census; no grazing action added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0847:b003:l029: Primary алапай exact widow/loss-of-composure expression; support and distress retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0847:b004:l010: Primary дүмөк threat/trouble; source's sixty retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0847:b004:l022: Бозалалуу read with primary бозала gray-mottled; Kyzyl-Too retained as named mountain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0847:b004:l023: Primary бейпай torment/suffering, бейпай сал cause devastation. Broad torment wording restored; no unstated target assigned in the cave-work/killings narrative.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0847:b004:l033: Курч sharp iron/tools with ensuing steel mattocks; no invented bronze material.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b003:l001: 1960 glossary PDF372 explicitly defines көөлө as hollowing out.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b003:l003: Шексиз rendered not suspicious in the hidden-entrance context, a qualified contextual reading rather than certainty.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b003:l011: Primary көөр precious stone/pearl, жакут ruby; treasure terminology retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b003:l018: Шексиз refers contextually to avoiding suspicion at the hidden entrance.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b003:l021: Шексиз read contextually as not arousing suspicion; construction method in preceding verse remains held.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b003:l030: Primary баканооз informer/spy includes this poem's stranger and informer warning; no invented official rank.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b003:l038: Primary ным II early night when people first lie asleep, not moisture.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b004:l005: Боорум literally my liver; the organ cry follows poisoned drink. The word also has kinship uses; literal rendering retained without assigning a kinship addressee.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b004:l006: Primary окчонтой quiver, exact expression filling it with arrows. No gun or shooting action supplied.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b004:l013: Primary тундурма sense2 quotes burial of five men at the hearth with surface leveled. Exact burial context supports rendering.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b004:l015: Таңдамаашар Day of Judgment; narrator's acknowledged guilt for innocent men retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b004:l027: Source's gendered comparison retained without endorsement or modernization.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0848:b004:l037: Бейдаарат without ritual ablutions; religious polemic retained in narrative voice.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b003:l005: Violent human-body trophies belong to the source's military praise; retained without explanatory additions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b003:l010: Primary телегейи тең includes fortunate/everything favorable; used in paternal praise here.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b003:l011: 1960 glossary PDF375 defines Шай as warrior patron; not identified as an independently attested historical person.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b003:l012: Almighty/father comparison kept in its source verse; creation of another soul continues in the next verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b003:l014: Primary кылым II world/all peoples, not centuries. Twelve realms is provisional epic scope, not a historical count of states.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b003:l016: Primary укурук кайрар describes ability to repel an enemy. Source кайырар treated as a related variant in resistance context.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b003:l021: Канкор rendered bloodthirsty in the enemy's quoted description; other epic contexts may praise bravery instead.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b003:l023: Ок rendered missile without inventing a firearm in mixed epic weaponry.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b005:l004: Primary кастар тик- means intend evil/hostility; exact кастарын тигип cited. Hostile intent, not fixing one's gaze or silently emending to каш.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b005:l006: Primary мент I = мерт II maim/kill/destroy; unrelated to modern Russian slang for police.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b005:l010: Ombu retained as source place name; not automatically identified with Omsk.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b005:l013: Kyzylbash retained as source ethnonym without assigning a modern nationality.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b005:l026: Ажайып wonders rendered broadly; no invented palace, women, or specific spoils.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0849:b005:l038: Primary мөрт fitting/opportune occasion supports a fitting time to tell the tale.
